answer_1.quote: ...we explore Open-LTG with NAR models based on pre-trained MLMs... experiments on two Open-LTG tasks (i.e., storytelling and multi-paragraph opinionated article writing) with four widely-used datasets...
answer_1.outputs: Generated stories and multi-paragraph opinionated articles

answer_2.quote: ...we utilize BLEU, ROUGE, Distinct, BERTScore, and Perplexity for evaluation... also report Lexical Repetition (LR), Semantic Repetition (SR)...

answer_4.quote: ...we hire three annotators to give their preferences (win, loss and tie) for three evaluation criteria: fluency, coherence, and relevance...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were shown a prompt and two model outputs and asked to select the better text in terms of fluency, coherence, and relevance.
